name: The Münchelstrasse Oaks

official_register.name: LUBW Schutzgebietsverzeichnis Baden-Württemberg, Naturdenkmal Einzelgebilde 82210001208 and 82210001209

access: Stands on or beside Münchelstrasse, mapped in OpenStreetMap as a public track (highway=track, no access restriction seen). No source states opening conditions; evidence only.
transport: Ziegelhausen, Heidelberg; bus to Ziegelhausen then an uphill walk on Münchelstrasse (exact stop and time not verified).
verify_notes: Two separately registered pedunculate oaks, 82210001208 'Stieleiche Münchelstrasse (1)' (LUBW map centre 49.416813, 8.77382) and 82210001209 '(2)' (49.417398, 8.774223), about 70 m apart, folded into one entry. Both designated 1951-04-05. The register's 'Linde Münchelstrasse' (82210001211, 49.418177, 8.774663, also designated 1951-04-05, about 50 m further on) belongs to the same group and could be named in the story; no photo of it found. Coordinates are LUBW-derived map centres (de.wikipedia comment: 'von Kartenmittelpunkt (LUBW) abgeleitet'), so approximate; the Commons Object location on both photos is identical to the register centre, so it is not an independent GPS fix. Alive: both trunks photographed 2024-11-04 by Commons user Albrecht62 (CC BY-SA 4.0), files 'Stieleiche Münchelstraße-1.jpg' (pageid 154870714) and 'Stieleiche Münchelstraße-2.jpg' (pageid 154870908), Commons category Natural monuments in Heidelberg. Species: register name 'Stieleiche' plus Commons description; single register source, so flagged 'register only'. No girth, height or age found: LUBW Steckbriefe carry none (earlier pass 2026-10-14), no other source found in two searches. Age left empty; the page asks the reader. Photo route is open (photographs exist), judging the frame is for the photo pass. Not verified: whether the trunks stand on public ground or beside the track.
